name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Switch to Mistral Large 2 12.8B for all EXCAVA prompts. Its 128K context window crushes Llama 4 Maverick 12B’s 100K limit, letting us feed full project docs without truncation—critical for long-form analysis where context loss kills quality. The trade-off is raw speed: Mistral Large 2 runs ~20% slower than Maverick, but the context gain outweighs the lag for EXCAVA’s core work.

name: Torque
text: Mistral Large 2’s 128K window is a red herring—EXCAVA’s prompts spike to 20K, so truncation isn’t the bottleneck. The real risk is prompt collapse under long contexts, which Maverick 12B handles better despite its 100K claim. Test both on a 20K prompt with a full project doc: if Mistral’s output degrades while Maverick’s holds, switch.
